# Tag

A small outlined label that names a category, person, agent or team. It can also act as a link, a toggle or a removable chip, depending on its props.

Also asked as: label, keyword.

**Import:** `import { Tag } from '@/components';`

## Usage

- **Is it a number?** Count tag.
- **Is it the condition something is in, and can that condition change?** Status tag.
- **Otherwise** (a subject, a focus area, a person, a category): Tag.

Who set the value no longer decides. A tag is outlined and a status is filled,
so a reader tells a category from a meaning without reading the words.

## Best practices

### Use one color per category. {#use-one-color-per-category}

A color names a category; changing it inside one category reads as a different one.

Do: One color for one category.
Don't: Rainbow inside one category.

### Keep color for a category, never a status. {#keep-color-for-a-category-never-a-status}

Pick a color per category and keep it stable, or leave every tag gray. A condition that can change is a Status tag.

Do: A stable color for a category.
Don't: Green reads as "went well" beside anything red.

### Show selection with the selected state. {#show-selection-with-the-selected-state}

Selection is a state of the tag, never a new color.

Do: Selected state.
Don't: A new color for selected.

### Add a swatch only when color is the way to find the tag. {#add-a-swatch-only-when-color-is-the-way-to-find-the-tag}

A plain tag is its outline and neutral words. Turn on `swatchBefore` for a tag that is a legend entry or a color-coded filter, where the reader matches the square to a chart or a key. An icon in `elemBefore` is for when the icon carries meaning of its own.

```jsx
<Tag color="blue">Lincoln Middle</Tag>                                  {/* plain: outline only */}
<Tag color="blue" swatchBefore>Lincoln Middle</Tag>                       {/* the tag's own color */}
<Tag swatchBefore="background-accent-orange-bolder">Week 3</Tag>   {/* a background color token */}
<Tag elemBefore={<Icon name="star" />}>Starred</Tag>                {/* an icon that means something */}
```

### Let the props pick the kind of tag. {#let-the-props-pick-the-kind-of-tag}

```jsx
// Read-only, the default: a value on show.
<Tag>Grade 4</Tag>

// Removable: a value the person can take out.
<Tag isRemovable onAfterRemoveAction={drop}>Grade 4</Tag>

// Selectable: a filter or an answer chip, with its result count.
<Tag isSelected={on} onClick={toggle} trailingMetric={12}>Science</Tag>

// Link, and a link with a separate ×.
<Tag href="/sites/lincoln-middle">Lincoln Middle</Tag>
<Tag href="/sites/lincoln-middle" isRemovable onAfterRemoveAction={drop}>Lincoln Middle</Tag>
```

`isSelected` is a boolean on purpose: `false` is an unselected toggle, and
leaving it out is a tag that is not selectable. `trailingMetric` is for
selectable tags only; anywhere else it is ignored with a warning.

### Use the type for who, not for what. {#use-the-type-for-who-not-for-what}

Person, agent and team tell people who something belongs to; topics stay plain.

Do: Types name the owner.
Don't: Plain tags hide the owner.

`avatar` takes an image source or a node. Leave it out, or let it fail, and
initials stand in without moving the tag. On a plain tag it is ignored with a
warning.

### Lift a tag onto an image with `isElevated`. {#lift-a-tag-onto-an-image-with-iselevated}

```jsx
// A subject on a lesson thumbnail, 8 from the corner.
<Tag color="blue" isElevated>Lincoln Middle</Tag>
<Tag href="/lessons/42" color="magenta" isElevated>Open lesson</Tag>
```

Read-only and link only: a value is edited off the image. On a removable or
selectable tag `isElevated` is ignored with a warning.

### Disable one tag, or the whole field. {#disable-one-tag-or-the-whole-field}

`isDisabled` disables one tag. A field or group that is disabled says so once,
and every tag inside follows:

```jsx
<Tag isDisabled>Grade 4</Tag>

<TagContext.Provider value={{ isDisabled: true }}>
    <Tag isRemovable onAfterRemoveAction={drop}>Grade 4</Tag>
</TagContext.Provider>
```

`useTagContext()` reads the same value from inside a custom tag.

### Let the group own the gaps. {#let-the-group-own-the-gaps}

`Tag` sets no margin of its own. A row of tags is a `TagGroup`, which sets
`gap` once for the set.

## Accessibility

- **A removable tag is not itself a control.** The × is, and a button inside a
  button is invalid, so the tag is a `span` with one button in it.
- **The × is named from the label.** It announces `Remove Science`;
  `removeButtonLabel` overrides that when the label is not text.
- **Selectable publishes `aria-pressed`**, so the state is not only visible.
  Selected also changes the border to the full hue, so it does not rest on a
  change of lightness alone. A selectable tag given `aria-expanded` is a button
  that opens something, such as TagGroup's `+n`: it publishes the expanded
  state and no `aria-pressed`.
- **A link with a × is two tab stops**, link then ×, and pressing the × never
  follows the link.
- **Saving is announced once.** The spinner is hidden; a status region beside
  the tag, outside its name, says "Saving". The × and a link stay focusable
  but do nothing until the save lands.
- **A × needs a name.** When the label is not text, pass `removeButtonLabel`, or the
  × is named only "Remove" and development warns.
- **An elevated tag's focus ring has a surface gap.** The 2px between the tag
  (or a link's ×) and the ring is filled in the surface color, so the ring
  reads on a dark picture.
- **Disabled tags take no focus, and say they are disabled.** They come from
  `isDisabled` or a disabled field. A selectable tag is a native disabled button, announced as
  disabled. Every other tag is a span, which has no disabled state a screen
  reader announces, so it ends with visually hidden text and is read as
  "Science, disabled".
- **A clipped label keeps its full text** in a tooltip that hover and keyboard
  focus both reach. On a control the control carries it; on a plain tag the
  label takes focus while, and only while, it is clipped.
- **The swatch and the avatar are decoration** and are hidden from assistive
  technology; an avatar image has empty alt text. The tag's words name the
  person, agent or team, so the initials are never read out or folded into the
  ×'s name.

## Related

- For a set of tags, use `TagGroup`: it owns the gaps and the overflow.
- For a number on its own, use `CountTag`.
- For a labeled field where the person picks, creates and removes tags, use `TagInput`.
- For a state, use `StatusTag`.

Same group: `AiMessage` · `ChangeTag` · `CountTag` · `DateTag` · `PromptStarters` · `SmartTag` · `StatusTag` · `Suggestion` · `TagGroup`

## Parts

1. **Lead, optional.** Nothing by default. A 10 swatch (`swatchBefore`), an icon (`elemBefore`), or for a person, an agent or a team a 16 avatar.
2. **Label.** Neutral text; the hue never colors the words.
3. **Trailing metric.** Optional on a selectable tag: a compact Count tag, such as a filter's result count.
4. **Remove button.** Optional, with the 2px focus ring on the button itself and a name that says what it removes.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Outlined, clear ground, the hue on the border. 22 tall. |
| Hovered, pressed | A link or a selectable tag takes the accent's subtlest and subtlest pressed steps; a link's words underline. On a removable tag only the × reacts. |
| Selected | The subtler ground with a full-hue border, held under hover and press. |
| Focused | A 2px ring 2px off the edge, on the tag or on the ×. |
| Disabled | Disabled ground and words, no ×, no link, no focus; a selected tag keeps a bold edge. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Rest edge | `--ds-border-accent-blue-subtle`, and the same step for each hue. |
| Hovered, pressed | `--ds-background-accent-blue-subtlest` and `--ds-background-accent-blue-subtlest-pressed`. |
| Selected | `--ds-background-accent-blue-subtler` with a `--ds-border-accent-blue` edge. |
| Words | `--ds-text` on every hue. |
| Disabled | `--ds-background-disabled`, `--ds-text-disabled`, `--ds-icon-disabled`. |
| Padding, gap, corner | `--pad-x-xs`, `--stack-sm`, `--radius-md`; a person tag is `--radius-full`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the thing in a word or two: "Science", "Grade 6". | Write a sentence or a full instruction. |
| Use sentence case and the singular. | Use ALL CAPS or a trailing punctuation mark. |
| Give a × a name that says the value: "Remove Science". | Leave every × named "Remove". |
| Keep one wording for one category across the product. | Rename the same category per screen. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `text` | string | — | The label (alternative to children). |
| `children` | node | — | The label (takes precedence over `text`). |
| `color` | enum | `'gray'` | A category color: an accent family, on the border (and on the swatch when `swatchBefore` is on). Never a status. On an avatar type the border is neutral and the color fills the avatar; gray agents fill discovery (the AI purple) and gray teams the lightest blue. |
| `type` | oneOf | `'plain'` | What the tag names. `plain` leads with nothing unless `swatchBefore` or `elemBefore` is set; `person` (round), `agent` (hexagon) and `team` (square) lead with a 16 avatar. |
| `avatar` | string or node | — | The avatar of a person, agent or team tag: an image source, or a node. Missing or broken, it falls back to initials. Decorative. |
| `trailingMetric` | number or string | — | Selectable tags only: a compact neutral Count tag after the label, such as a filter's result count. Ignored with a warning elsewhere. |
| `elemBefore` | node | — | The leading icon slot, empty by default: an icon in front of the text, for when the icon carries meaning. Plain tags only: an avatar type leads with its avatar. Sits after `swatchBefore` when both are set. |
| `swatchBefore` | bool or string | — | A 10 color square in front of the text, off by default, for a tag that uses color for wayfinding such as a chart legend entry. `true` draws it in the tag's own color; a background color token (`background-accent-blue-bolder`, or `--ds-background-accent-blue-bolder`) draws a custom one. Never a raw CSS color. Plain tags only. |
| `maxWidth` | number or string | `180` | Caps the whole tag (default 180). A clipped label ellipsizes and shows its full text as a tooltip. |
| `href` | string | — | Makes the tag a link to this address. |
| `linkComponent` | elementType | — | Router link to render instead of `<a>` for a link tag. |
| `isSelected` | bool | — | Makes the tag a toggle, true or false: it publishes `aria-pressed` and fires `onClick`. Leave it out for a tag that is not selectable. |
| `isRemovable` | bool | `false` | Adds a Remove button, with the 2px focus ring on the button itself. Not shown while the tag is disabled. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | — | Disables this tag. A field disables all of its tags through `TagContext`. |
| `isLoading` | bool | `false` | Saving: a spinner replaces the swatch, icon or avatar and the tag ignores presses until it is done. |
| `isElevated` | bool | `false` | For a tag on an image or video: a solid surface fill, no border and the Elevation 2 shadow, with the hue kept on the swatch, when there is one, or the avatar's own fill. Disabled keeps the ground and shadow and turns the content Secondary (Text). Focus on the tag or a link's × has a surface gap inside the ring. Read-only and link tags only; ignored with a warning on removable and selectable ones. |
| `onClick` | func | — | Fires on a selectable tag and on a link. |
| `onAfterRemoveAction` | func | — | Called with the tag's text and the event after the Remove button is pressed. The caller removes the tag. |
| `removeButtonLabel` | string | — | Overrides the Remove button's accessible name. Defaults to `Remove <label>`. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the tag element. |
| `id` | string | — | Id set on the tag element. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style on the tag element, merged over the `maxWidth` cap. |
